Details
  • Paper: RF-DETR: Neural Architecture Search for Real-Time Detection Transformers, ICLR 2026, 2025-11-12
  • Original code: https://github.com/roboflow/rf-detr at 5b22dfc09406
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/roboflow/rf-detr/blob/5b22dfc0940697ce1abdfa681a5f7392b3eddbfb/README.md#keypoints
  • Training data: COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), LVD-142M (DINOv2's curated web-image set, not released) (Author README: pretrained on COCO person keypoints; DINOv2-small backbone originates from LVD-142M pretraining. Full intermediate training provenance is not stated.)
  • Options: score_threshold = 0.5 (0.0 to 1.0)
  • Kernel libraries: fastbb
  • Variants: rf-detr-keypoint-preview
  • Outputs: keypoints, keypoint_scores, boxes, scores; label_set: coco-keypoints-17
  • Input size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): rf-detr-keypoint-preview 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.6 reserved)
  • rf-detr-keypoint-preview 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 48 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 67 s (ONNX + engine).
  • rf-detr-keypoint-preview original (fp32) 1080x1920: pinned RF-DETR torchvision resize/normalize, original network and uncertainty-fused PostProcess
  • rf-detr-keypoint-preview original 1080x1920: the authors' float16 model option; pinned RF-DETR torchvision resize/normalize, original network and uncertainty-fused PostProcess; authors inference(compile=False, dtype=float16, inplace=True)
  • rf-detr-keypoint-preview load / first call: original 1.49 s / 0.083 s, portable 2.66 s / 0.386 s, kernels 2.7 s / 0.384 s
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Bottom-up on all 5,000 validation images, no ground-truth boxes; people ranked by their predicted person score, after model-specific decoding; pycocotools OKS AP. Limitations

  • Requires the optional transformers and torchvision libraries.
  • This is the Apache-2.0 Keypoint Preview checkpoint; restricted RF-DETR Plus detection variants are not included.
  • module() exports raw boxes, class logits and keypoint predictions; confidence fusion and thresholding remain outside the exported graph.
  • Float16 and float32 may retain different people near the score threshold; raw query ordering can differ across export engines.
  • torch.compile uses upstream positional-interpolation graph breaks; fullgraph=True is unsupported. Fixed-shape torch.export and ONNX remain supported.
